content: Electron has the mature signing/notarization/auto-update story (electron-builder handles code signing, Squirrel.Mac/NSIS auto-update). Tauri v2 has a younger release-engineering ecosystem but smaller binaries/less attack surface. macOS requires notarization beyond signing since 10.15, or Gatekeeper blocks the app. Windows requires certs on FIPS 140-2 hardware since June 2023 (no more file-based .pfx download); EV only needed for kernel-mode drivers, OV is sufficient for standard apps. SmartScreen reputation builds over download count/time even after signing.
